securityScope: No actual theatre datasets, real venue identifiers, personal photographs, EXIF payloads, credentials or repository history are included. Authored geometric imagery and demo screenshots are included.
Inactive client interface modules remain for existing UI compatibility; no server implementation or deployment configuration is included.
Remote service settings and admin route are disabled; query-driven loopback registration is removed.
CSP allows same-origin asset and JSON requests; browser security restrictions do not replace a service security review.
Local files opened by a visitor may be kept in browser storage only through explicit UI actions. A shared origin is not an isolation boundary.
No network capture, penetration test, real-device acceptance, or online reference reverification is claimed by the static suites.

storageSemantics.reload: For the current theatre and model, restore the most recently saved preset by updatedAt. Unsaved edits and merely loading another preset do not automatically become the newest saved preset.
storageSemantics.layoutImport: One layout JSON, at most 256 KiB, is added to the saved list; the user then chooses Load to apply it. Original photos are not included.
storageSemantics.personalDataArchive: Export-only archive of saved layouts, personal notes and lens settings. No full-archive restore UI; photographs and login data excluded.

iabDownloadedFileRoundTrip.environment: In-app browser, not a physical phone.

testCleanup.method: Delete both round-trip test layouts individually and reload.

downloadedArtifactValidation.scope: The actual downloaded JSON was read directly, imported and loaded with the public storage module in memory. This complements the observed browser file-import/apply round trip.
downloadedArtifactValidation.equalityBasis: Complete state deep equality. New preset identifiers and timestamps are intentional import changes, so byte-identical files before and after import are not claimed.

remainingLimitations: Chrome download-event tracking timed out and was not repeatedly retried. The actual downloaded-file round-trip result belongs to IAB only.
Import creates a new preset identifier and timestamps. Verification compares the complete restored state rather than asserting byte identity of pre-import and post-import files.
Full reset was not tested. Individual deletion and empty-list recovery after reload were verified.
No physical-phone acceptance test was performed.
